answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 51868 Country: India Title: Islamic Name Question: Ma-shaAllah, I have a son and I want to use Jalal Ahamad name for him. Can I use this name or not? Or can I use Muhammad Jalal? Please tell me good answer for my son's bright future. Answer ID: 51868 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 816/665/B=05/1435) Yes, you may keep the name Jalal Ahmad or Muhammad Jalal to your son. Both the names are correct. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
